method: Anonymous native rendering of fictional complete pages. Three exact argument-free whole headings intentionally acquire their plain labels. A literal malformed break becomes a native line break and one horizontal space before a reference marker disappears. References, list items and protected literal controls remain equal. Raw responses and HTML remain private.

zeroArgumentHeadingContracts.allowedShape: An exact whole heading containing a single template call with no arguments
zeroArgumentHeadingContracts.earlyReturn: if not entityId then return nil end
zeroArgumentHeadingContracts.condition: The absent first parent argument reaches the nil return before any entity lookup.

zeroArgumentHeadingContracts.allowedShape: An exact whole heading containing a single template call with no arguments
zeroArgumentHeadingContracts.pageListConstruction: preprocessDisplays collects only numeric parent arguments
zeroArgumentHeadingContracts.condition: No numeric parent arguments produce an empty page list. The label from frame.args is separate and cannot supply a page name.
